title: Joint Health
body:
I had knee joint pain that came on suddenly in both knees in early February 2021. An X-Ray
revealed osteoarthritis. It occurs when the protective cartilage that cushions the ends of the
bones wears down over time. I had pain while climbing or descending stairs. Even walking
was painful. Running was not possible.
Since I was 74 years old, this was a terrifying sign of impending knee replacement. I saw a
documentary on knee replacement surgery and
I will do almost anything to avoid it.
An Infomercial on TV claimed that Purity Products JointGel was clinically tested and proven to
restore joint cartilage. I ordered it on May 16, 2021 and I used it for 3 months until I found out
it was made with Pig gelatin. It did help reduce the pain. I switched to beef gelatin and MSM
on November 3rd 2021 and the pain slowly came back. I switched back to pig gelatin April 21
2022. I have been back on pig gelatin and MSM for about 3 weeks and have noticed
incredible improvement. I cant run yet but hope to soon.
Update: It has now been one month with the pig protocol and I am able to run again (albeit
slowly)!
I ran across a treehugger.com article that stated "Pig DNA is much closer to human DNA than
previously thought." I concluded an increased risk of autoimmune diseases and decided to
play it safe and not eat pork. For example, there is a proven increased risk of multiple
sclerosis with pork consumption. See below.
However, for joint repair the closeness to human DNA is probably of key importance. Also,
hydrolyzed pork gelatin did not work as well for me.

https://nutritionreview.org/2016/12/gelatin-vitamin-c-promote-collagen-regeneration-in-

12 mg (milligrams) of lysine for every kilo of body weight. I take 4000mg per day.
https://steptohealth.com/quickly-regenerate-damaged-cartilage/
Now, at 76 years old, I have no pain while going up and down stairs, walking, or even running.
I have exercised every morning, except when I was sick, for the last 40 years. Since I can
exercise again, have been able to regain my strength. I regard this supplementation as a
miracle.

devastating autoimmune condition involving the central nervous system. While pork-averse
nations like Israel and India were nearly spared from MS’s degenerative grips, more liberal
consumers, such as West Germany and Denmark, faced sky-high rates."
https://www.healthline.com/nutrition/is-pork-bad
There is a high probability of an increase risk of other autoimmune diseases from eating pork.
